title: Sometimes God works the most in the quiet seasons.
paragraphs: Sometimes God works the most in the quiet seasons.

When prayers feel unanswered
When heaven feels silent
When your heart feels heavy…
“The Lord is close to the brokenhearted.” — Psalm 34:18

God has not stepped away from you.
He is closer than you realize.

You are not abandoned.
You are not forgotten.
You are not alone.

If someone needs this reminder tonight…
share this with them.
Have you ever experienced a season where God felt silent but later realized He was still working?
